test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In the year 2021, which of the following ministries published the amended rules related to Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)?

options.text: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

solution:
The correct answer is the __**Ministry of Corporate Affairs**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ministry of Corporate Affairs published the amended rules related to Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) in the year 2021.
 
• These amendments aimed to clarify certain provisions, enhance transparency, and promote effective implementation of CSR activities by companies.
 
• The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) is a government department in India responsible for overseeing and regulating the corporate sector.
 
• It plays a crucial role in promoting transparency, accountability, and good governance within companies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Ministry of New and Renewable Energy:** This ministry is responsible for promoting the development and utilization of new and renewable energy sources in India.
 
• **Ministry of Home Affairs:** This ministry is responsible for internal security, law and order, and border management in India.
 
• **Ministry of Science and Technology:** This ministry is responsible for promoting scientific research, development, and innovation in India.
